subject: Cleanup meetup: unexpected bin rental
text: Hi, quick update on the neighborhood cleanup meetup. I just discovered that the borrowed bins will be returned before Saturday, so we need to rent two more from the hardware place. That adds an unexpected $85, and I don't want to charge volunteers late. Can you check whether the event contingency has any remaining funds? If not, I could ask the park office to absorb the cost, but they need a written request by noon. Please send the approval or a no as soon as possible so I can confirm the rental. The weather window is tight. The schedule is unchanged otherwise. I have not booked anything yet. I can pay upfront if you need me to. It is urgent.
